source_quote:
I think `EncoderOnly` is an `AttentionType` instead of `AscendAttentionState`, why we put it here?
let's make attention spec in model_runner_v1.py#L3287
I guess you want to make sure `forward_encoder` will be stepped into when the attn type is `ENCODE_ONLY`. However I think it has no relation to `AscendAttentionState`, which mainly refers to the requests state (whether it is chunked) in current batch. I recomand to include `forward_encoder` into each `_forward_xxx`(`_forward_prefill_no_cache`, `_forward_prefill_cache_hit`, `_forward_decode_only` and `_forward_v1_style`), so that it could be compatible with different schedulers and batch states
I get your point, but I think it still not quite like a state. It is unique that no decode phase for encoder-only model, which has no autoregression process.
> The `AscendAttentionState` actually just used to adapt `AscendScheduler`, a v0 style scheduler, which process prefill and decode req seperately. If you ensure this pr not support `AscendScheduler`, I think we should move the current `_forward_encoder` into `_forward_v1_style`
Okay, then let's keep aligh with vllm first
this logic will make an all-zeros matrix for the other type models, too. I think it is a bug?
CI failed may due to the download conflict while downloading. Plz help to take a look @Potabk
This couldn't be removed as this is required by `torch_npu.npu_fusion_attention`
Thanks for this cleanup!
plz don't remove the reason and plan of this patch, thus we could remove it in the future
why we need a full-zeros mask? this seems weird
Actually I'm confused about this change. Alough there is only prefill in encoder-only scenario, it is not recommanded to set attn_state accordding to model type
Removing this seems a bug, this will make no attention operators could use for encoder-only
QQ: why specifying `num_tokens` to 2 here?
Thanks for the details, I got your point now
we need to remove the issue link here, let's do this after CI passes
(post-merge comment: 关于冗余判断逻辑的后续清理建议)

rule.description: 在添加 pooling 模型支持时，应正确使用 `AttentionType`（如 ENCODER_ONLY）来标识模型类型，而非将其混入 `AscendAttentionState`（用于描述请求的调度状态）。encoder-only 模型的 forward 逻辑应合并到现有的 `_forward_v1_style` 中，以保持与不同调度器和批次状态的兼容性。
checkpoints: 是否混淆了 `AttentionType` 和 `AscendAttentionState` 的概念
pooling 模型的 mask 是否正确设置为全零矩阵（非 causal）
是否保持了与 vllm 上游的一致性
删除代码时是否保留了 patch 的原因和计划说明
文档中是否在 CI 通过后清理了 issue 链接

antipattern.code:
# 评审人: MengqingCao 👤 (2025-10-13)
# Commit: ea6c1f2, 64b829d, 8a443a6 等多次修改
# 错误地将 EncoderOnly 混入 AscendAttentionState

class AscendAttentionState:
    PrefillNoCache = "prefill_no_cache"
    PrefillCacheHit = "prefill_cache_hit"
    DecodeOnly = "decode_only"
    ChunkedPrefill = "chunked_prefill"
    EncoderOnly = "encoder_only"  # 混淆了 AttentionType 和 AscendAttentionState

# model_runner_v1.py - 根据模型类型设置 attn_state（不推荐）
if is_encoder_only:
    attn_state = AscendAttentionState.EncoderOnly

# 将 _forward_encoder 逻辑合并到 _forward_v1_style 中

    PrefillNoCache = "prefill_no_cache"
    PrefillCacheHit = "prefill_cache_hit"
    DecodeOnly = "decode_only"
    ChunkedPrefill = "chunked_prefill"
    # EncoderOnly 已移除

# model_runner_v1.py - pooling 模型使用 is_causal_pooling 标识
attn_metadata.is_causal_pooling = not is_causal
# 非 causal pooling 使每个 query 关注所有 token
